failure_summary.description: Agents skipped required searches or filters, failed to save results, returned a premature no-op, or unnecessarily duplicated an unchanged cached result.
Agents overlooked dates or routes already in context, blocked ready searches while seeking information, or asked for optional preferences as though required.
An agent mapped a broad suitability request to an unrelated hotel amenity.

patch.reasoning: These failures already contradict explicit skill guidance: save generated results, apply new criteria, avoid premature no-ops, use conversation context, execute independent complete domains, ask only for missing required inputs, and omit unsupported preferences. The protected section also reiterates the cache workflow. Repeating those instructions would not address a gap in the skill.
